title: emit_descendant_removals reads POST-tx snapshot — cascade delete on multi-table tx
description: Trigger shape for B11: parent.related('child', q => q.related('grandchild')) where a single transaction deletes the parent. The grandchildren are deleted by FK cascade in the same tx. Rust's emit_descendant_removals opens a fresh read connection on `db_path` AFTER swap_snapshot has pointed it at curr — so descendants gone in the same tx are NOT in curr.db and are silently elided. TS pipeline-driver materializes the diff from `prev` BEFORE swapping, so the descendants ARE seen. Mutation: DELETE FROM channels WHERE id = 'b11-test' (with FK cascade DELETE configured); TS emits Remove rows for descendant conversations + messages, RS does not.

spec_source.ts_lines: 1542-1577 (upstream ref) — diff iterator from prev BEFORE swapSnapshot(curr)
spec_source.rust_lines_primary: 464-477 (emit_descendant_removals opens conn on db_path = curr post-swap)
spec_source.rust_lines_secondary: 1856 (db_path lock cloned into advance — needs prev_db_path companion)

wave1_action: After B11 fix lands (set_prev_snapshot napi method + descendant SQL routed to prev_db_path), re-run with cascade-delete mutation; assert TS and RS emit identical Remove rows for descendants.
wave1_setup_hint: Phase 34 schema.sql does NOT enable ON DELETE CASCADE on the existing FKs (channels→conversations→messages). Wave 1 task: either add CASCADE constraints OR introduce a deeper cascade fixture in seed-extras.sql for this stub. The current AST and mutation block document the SHAPE; Wave 1 makes it executable.

mutation_block.undo: DELETE FROM messages WHERE id = 'b11-m'; DELETE FROM conversations WHERE id = 'b11-co'; DELETE FROM channels WHERE id = 'b11-test'

mutation_block.label: B11 trigger: delete parent and all descendants in a single tx (manual cascade since FK CASCADE is not enabled)
mutation_block.run: BEGIN; DELETE FROM messages WHERE "conversationId" = 'b11-co'; DELETE FROM conversations WHERE "channelId" = 'b11-test'; DELETE FROM channels WHERE id = 'b11-test'; COMMIT;
